description: The Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) and the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA) held an Industry Day on Wednesday, March 25, 2026, from 9:30am to 11:45am at 5600 Fishers Lane, Rockville MD 20857. We appreciate your participation and the valuable questions submitted.  This posting contains the consolidated questions and answers.  As we look ahead, we anticipate hosting our next Industry Day in March 2027 and encourage you to continue monitoring SAM.gov and future communications for updates and engagement opportunities.
